_doc: The owner's answers to the projected $/WAR path questions (VAL_5), append-only and hash-chained: each row carries prev_sha256, the sha256 of the previous row's canonical JSON (64 zeros for the first). A changed answer is a NEW row, never an edit; where an id has several rows, the last row for that id in chain order binds.

The writer reads the conventions (OD-1 to OD-5, OD-8) from here by option CODE. OD-6 and OD-7 are read ONLY from the dpw_path_gate block's owner_at_amendment (and OD-7 option zero_if_floor only from owner_after_look), as they stood in the pre-look amendment commit (docs/dpw-2026-09-25/DPW_PATH_GATE.md sections 9, 12). Excluded from the public webroot.

answers.answer: **Serve at the past-winter pass** (the owner departed from the recommended "wait for two unseen winters"); two misses in a row on new winters reverse it
